text:
For both parts of this exercise, give a geometric description of sets of the vectors $\bvec$ and include a sketch.

For which vectors $\bvec$ in $\real^2$ is the equation $$ \left[\begin{array}{rr} 3 \amp -6 \\ -2 \amp 4 \\ \end{array}\right] \xvec = \bvec $$ consistent?

For which vectors $\bvec$ in $\real^2$ is the equation $$ \left[\begin{array}{rr} 3 \amp -6 \\ -2 \amp 2 \\ \end{array}\right] \xvec = \bvec $$ consistent?
